title: Glasswing
description: A fast 3D side-scrolling forest action game designed by Charles. Four black wings, a white mask, a needle-sword. When your mask breaks, become a glass cannon. Solo and two players on one keyboard. English and French.
controls: Arrows or WASD: move. Space: jump, again for double jump, hold to glide.
J: punch / kick. K: sword. L: blast, hold to charge. Shift: dodge. U: block / parry.
Two players: WASD + F G H R T; arrows + J K L Shift I. Gamepads supported.
credits: Designed by Charles. Produced by Cedric Bernadac.
Developed by Nilo with Codex. Original procedural art; external media pending.
